text: Read cfd/20261118-7 collect-1; the run may be wiped. (1) cfd-25 landed (6c7a488). scientific_tasks[].refinement now requires skill, inputs and ratio_row, plus either order_row (an order from a source) or third_inputs (a third run, finer again by the same ratio, each input from a row), from which the order is observed. Its rejected fixture was watched accepted first. The template part is yours. Note that with three grids the person's factor 3 does not apply: by 'Yes, factor 3' a three-or-more-grid estimate keeps no factor (tolerance_from_reference@v3's three_or_more_grids, 13d3955). (2) cfd-27 landed (b073771): testfolder.py session points XDG_CACHE_HOME at <run>/tmp/cache beside TMPDIR. Other HOME-relative caches are named by each program and are not set; a further one is added when a run shows it. The 490 files already in ~/.cache/fenics are the person's to remove, as you said.
